about: S5 art ramps for our clouds (CLOUDS_3D_RESEARCH_2026-10-20.md sections 5 and 8; loaded by ps2_clouds_art.c).
Colours are NOT in this file: they come from the game every frame through C1 (lit = the game's LIGHT cloud
colour, shadow = its DARK one, fog, sky_top, sky_hor, sky_below, incloud). This file says how S2 (far) and S3
(near) mix them and shape the clouds, per cloud kind.
Selection: 'missions' (mission number -> kind), then 'env_type' (raw env set +0x190 -> kind), else 'default'.
A kind inherits 'default' and overrides keys.
Zero's own cloud shading, measured from its impostor builds (missions 1, 3, 7, 13: the same numbers). With
c = cos(view direction, sun_dir) and D(q) = the cloud's opacity 0..1 at q:
colour = mix(shadow, lit, t(c))
colour = mix(colour, lit, a_light(c) * D(p - s_light * sun_dir))   (lit, except a rim on the side away from the sun)
colour = mix(colour, shadow, a_dark(c) * D(p + s_dark * sun_dir))   (shadowed where cloud lies toward the sun)
s_light = rim_light / cloud_frac and s_dark = rim_dark / cloud_frac of a cloud's diameter (about 0.23 and 0.28).
The game evaluates t, a_light and a_dark once per frame with the camera's forward vector for all clouds on screen.
Ours should evaluate them per view direction, otherwise every cloud recolours when the head turns.
Curves: [[c, value], ...] points, or {a, b, min, max} = clamp(a + b c).
shape: C1 user[0] for B's density (base_period_m, detail_period_m, erosion, billow); 0 or missing = B's default.
ambient_top / ambient_base: extra mix toward sky_top on cloud tops and toward sky_below on bases (0 = the game,
which has none). fog: the game's fog colour and range from C1, times fog_scale, capped at fog_max.
near_fade_m / far_fade_m: the game's sprites fade in over 350..1000 m and out over 3..6 km. Our far map should
match the far fade. The near fade only exists because sprites cannot be flown through, so S3 ignores it.
shape (C1 user[0], B's density): [base-noise period m, detail period m, erosion 0..1, billow 0..1]; both periods
must divide 60000 m; [0, 0, 0, 0] = B's built-in defaults (4000, 600, 0.3, 0.5). The game's clouds are soft
painterly puffs: keep erosion low (detail erosion at 6-60 m reads as Flight Simulator).
shade (C1 shade -> user[1], cl_shade in cloud_common.glsl): base_darkening (t -= x (1 - local height)), thin_rim
(thin parts toward LIGHT), dark_core (dense cores toward DARK), dark_copy (strength of the 'cloud above' DARK copy).
art_k (C1 art_k -> user[3]) is derived, not set: (t a, t b, a_light a, a_dark a) of the selected curves.
near_art (C1 near_art -> user[2], S3): [incloud_mix (pull of samples deep in a blob toward C1 incloud),
near_contrast (lumps from density; per sample, ~3x attenuated along the ray: 0.5 gives the game's 20-28
level spread; keep <= 0.7 for comfort), extinction multiplier, light-sample weight (ACZ_VR_CLOUD_NEAR_LIGHT=1)].
Night (measured, mission 11): the game lights its clouds from the side opposite its night light (C1 sun_dir):
t = 0.404 - 0.407 c, a_light = 0.319 + 0.532 c, a_dark = 0.318 - 0.508 c with c = cos(view, sun_dir).
'sun_below' names a kind applied whenever sun_dir.y < 0 (no mission has that in S1's table).
incloud_t: C1 incloud while the game's sprites are dropped (our clouds on) or before any measurement = mix(shadow, lit, incloud_t); mission 1's measured in-cloud colour sits at 0.52 (0.2 levels off).

A/B 2026-10-21 (far renderer): cumulus 1000/300/0.35/0.8 (puffs ~1/6 of a 700 m cloud, as the game's impostors; still lozenge silhouettes: the blob profile dominates the outline in cl_density), overcast 4000/600/0.1/0.2 (M1 |diff| 17 -> 11.5 levels at field 2300).
S2 2026-10-21 gate 4: cumulus erosion 0.35 -> 0.12: with the core fill (ACZ_VR_CLOUD_FILL_CU) the detail erosion frayed the bank tops into a pixel-ragged edge at 3 km; 0.12 keeps soft lumps.

S2 2026-10-21 (S1's drawn sizes, CL_CLOUD_SPRITE: M3 bodies 2.5-6 km wide, 1-2.3 km tall): cumulus 3000/400 (was 1000/300: billows of ~125 m on a 4 km body are averaged away by the far march's noise prefilter and read as a smooth blob; at 3000 the mottling shows at 1-6 km; the outline lobes come from S2's envelope puffs, ACZ_VR_CLOUD_BILLOW).

incloud_t per kind: rain 0.62 (the game's frame inside mission 13's overcast, 116,134,134, sits at t 0.61-0.69 on its palette); C1 incloud also colours the cloud feel's volume, haze and cockpit light (ps2_video.c cloud_colour).

cumulus.about: broken fair-weather cumulus (mission 3): separate puffy clouds, soft edges, lit tops, dark rim below

overcast.about: stratus deck / overcast layer (mission 1): wide, flat, soft veil; strong haze

rain.about: rain overcast (missions 7, 13): flat and dim; the dome is brighter at the zenith than at the horizon

dusk.about: dusk (mission 6): golden LIGHT over a dark olive base; same model, the palette does the work

night.about: night (mission 11): dark brown clouds. C1 sun_dir is the night light the game draws as its disc (the env-set angles, +35 deg), but the clouds are lit from the opposite side: t lowest looking at the disc. Hence the negative t slope (art_k.y < 0 tells cl_shade to use c' = -c)
